name: axiom_fire_event
description: Fire a new event into Axiom for processing by event subscriptions and workflows.

name: axiom_list_projects
description: List existing Axiom projects with optional filtering by name, status, labels, and ref.

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by project name or issue ref (substring match)

parameters.name: filterStatus
parameters.description: Filter by status: Created, InProgress, Idle, Completed (comma-separated for multiple)

parameters.name: filterRef
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the project reference

name: axiom_get_project
description: Get details of a specific Axiom project including metadata, status, and reference.

name: axiom_get_task_status
description: Get the status and details of a specific task on a project.

name: axiom_add_thread_entry
description: Post an update or message to a project's conversation thread.

name: axiom_reopen_project
description: Reopen a previously closed Axiom project.

name: axiom_add_project_label
description: Add a label to an Axiom project for categorization and filtering.

name: axiom_remove_project_label
description: Remove a label from an Axiom project.

name: axiom_list_tools
description: List all custom tool definitions configured in Axiom.

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by tool name or description (substring match)

name: axiom_get_project_thread
description: Read the conversation thread for a project.

name: axiom_list_action_types
description: List all action types configured in Axiom. Action types run only from workflow action nodes; they cannot be invoked directly.

parameters.name: filterName
parameters.description: Filter by action type name (substring match)

name: axiom_list_agents
description: List all agents configured in Axiom.

name: axiom_update_project
description: Update an Axiom project's metadata such as name, body, or labels.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of labels to set on the project

name: axiom_update_project_body
description: Update an Axiom project's body with markdown content.

name: axiom_list_events
description: List events related to an Axiom project.

name: axiom_respond_to_task
description: Submit a response to a task that is waiting for human input.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The task ID awaiting a response

name: axiom_create_project
description: Create a new Axiom project programmatically.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of key-value metadata

name: axiom_get_activity_log
description: Get the global activity log, optionally filtered by project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 50)
